mapper.insert: insert into coach (openid, name, phone, password, sex, avatar, id_number, level, rating, service_radius_km, city_code, city_name, bio, status, create_time, update_time, create_user, update_user) values (#{openid}, #{name}, #{phone}, #{password}, #{sex}, #{avatar}, #{idNumber}, #{level}, #{rating}, #{serviceRadiusKm}, #{cityCode}, #{cityName}, #{bio}, #{status}, #{createTime}, #{updateTime}, #{createUser}, #{updateUser})
mapper.select:
select * from coach
and name like concat('%', #{name}, '%')
and phone like concat('%', #{phone}, '%')
and status = #{status}
order by create_time desc

select * from coach
status = 1
and city_code = #{cityCode}
order by rating desc, create_time desc
